description: PathValidationResult — per-link measurement: source_id, next_hop_id, destination_id, measured_rtt_ms, measured_loss_pct, valid_until, and the source's Ed25519 signature over the canonical encoding of the other fields. The spec defines the wire object fields, but there is NO TypeScript implementation yet. This vector is a SPEC-ONLY freeze of the canonical encoding so that any future TS/Rust/Go implementation produces byte-identical output.
statusNote: spec-only — no TS implementation exists in reference/ at the time of authoring. This vector FREEZES the expected canonical encoding. A future TS implementation MUST be byte-compatible with the hex values below. The encoding is proposed: domain SHARENET/PATH/VALIDATION/1, integer-keyed CBOR map per ADR-0004 (consistent with all other routing/economics objects).

constants.bodyEncoding: canonical CBOR (RFC 8949 §4.2.2), integer-keyed map per ADR-0004

bodyMapKeys.2: next_hop_id (text, NodeId of the next hop)
bodyMapKeys.4: measured_rtt_ms (uint, measured round-trip time in milliseconds)
bodyMapKeys.5: measured_loss_pct (uint, measured packet loss as a percentage 0-100)
bodyMapKeys.6: valid_until (uint, unix seconds — when this measurement expires)
bodyMapKeys.7: signature (bstr .size 64, Ed25519 by source over the canonical encoding of keys 1-6)

constants.note: Field names use snake_case (source_id, next_hop_id, destination_id, measured_rtt_ms, measured_loss_pct, valid_until) per spec/07 §4 wire-object declaration, mirroring the spec's prose. The integer keys (1-7) follow ADR-0004.

sharedKeys.note: Public key only — no secret-key material is committed. The source keypair was derived from a fixed 32-byte test seed inside the generator script for byte stability.

vectors.name: valid-path-validation
vectors.description: A source node measures RTT=42ms and loss=1% on the link to a next-hop toward the destination. The source signs the canonical encoding of the measurement (fields 1-6). The full PathValidationResult wire object (including the signature as field 7) is captured as hex.

verification: No TS implementation exists in reference/. The signature was computed using signMessage from reference/identity/keys.ts (Ed25519) over the canonical encoding of fields 1-6, prefixed by the proposed domain tag SHARENET/PATH/VALIDATION/1. The wire hex is canonicalEncode(integer-keyed map of fields 1-7).
notes: This vector is SPEC-ONLY: it freezes the expected canonical encoding so that future TS/Rust/Go implementations are byte-compatible. The domain tag is NOT yet registered in spec/14-security.md §4 (the protocol-registry.json declares the vector family, but the domain-tag registry entry will need to be added when the TS implementation lands). Per spec/07 §4: Path Validation is per-link, not end-to-end — the source accumulates PathValidationResults for each hop in the candidate path. The result is signed by the SOURCE (not the next-hop), as it is the source's measurement.
